item.title: Pokémon Go 'Halloween 2026 Part 2' event guide
item.description: Pokémon Go ’s second half of their 2026 Halloween event is rolling out (despite it being November now), and it runs from Nov. 1-5 . This portion of the event brings back some more old costumed Pokémon and includes the debut of shiny Greavard .

item.title: All map and weapon loot pool changes in the Fortnite Chapter 7 mini season
item.description: The Fortnite Chapter 7 mini season, titled " Treasure Hunters ," puts you on an island with several warring pirate crews. There's new map POIs, weapons, and items waiting as your treasure to claim as characters like Kasane Teto and Monkey D. Luffy make their Fortnite debuts.

item.title: All sprites in the Fortnite Chapter 7 mini season
item.description: Sprites have taken over another season with their inclusion in the Fortnite Chapter 7 mini season, " Treasure Hunters ." These sprites work functionally the same way as they did in the last seasons: find them around the island, level them up, and extract them to master them. Mastering sprites will unlock different rewards, like sprite dust and cosmetics.

item.title: All battle pass skins in the Fortnite Chapter 7 mini season
item.description: Fortnite 's Chapter 7 mini season , "Treasure Hunters," has kicked off, bringing a smaller battle pass alongside it (as one would expect from a shorter season). This battle pass is full of goodies, including two outfits featuring characters from One Piece and some anime-styled Fortnite characters.

item.title: The best local co-op games to play in 2026
item.description: As we approach the colder months, it's becoming the time when sitting inside and playing some of the best local co-op games is looking more and more appealing. Even though couch co-op and split-screen play is often pushed to the side in favor of online co-op, there are still plenty of modern games that allow players to sit side-by-side and play together. And believe it or not, some of those games are great!

item.title: 6 Perfect Star Trek Episodes to Watch to Say Goodbye to Patrick Stewart
item.description: Even more significant than the quantity of Star Trek that Stewart made was the quality. Kirk is in many ways a classic pulp action hero. He faces conflicts head on, never afraid to throw a punch or flirt with a sexy alien. Picard represents a different form of masculinity, valuing compassion, knowledge, and communication above all else. He is the endlessly patient father figure for his crew, and for the next generation of Star Trek viewers, presiding over one of the most beautiful visions of what the future could look like. It’s that connection that has left fans in mourning following his death on Thursday at the age of 86.

item.title: Doom Creator John Romero Revives Xbox-Canceled Game At New Publisher
item.description: The fate of the next game from Doom creator John Romero was in jeopardy after Xbox canceled the project last year. Thankfully, Romero confirmed in a new interview that the project will see the light of day, as his studio has found another publisher.

item.title: A Persona 1 Remake Is In Development, New Leak Suggests
item.description: Persona 4 Revival and Persona 6 aren't even out yet, and another Persona game has already leaked. Fittingly for Halloween, some new footage of an in-development Persona remake emerged online. It appears to be for a remake of Revelations: Persona , the first game in the series.

item.title: Itch.io Reveals Just How Much AI Slop Is Flooding Gaming Storefronts
item.description: A quick glance at Steam or itch.io shows how gaming storefronts are flooded with new games as more developers use generative AI, making it harder than ever for indie devs with hand-crafted games to stand out. A recent social media post by itch.io revealed some new data highlighting just how bad the situation has become.
